Container.Name: NexusBackup-Agent
Container.Overview: Nexus Backup local execution agent. It holds storage access and local backup credentials, runs restic/rclone/FUSE work and reports jobs back to NexusBackup-Control. Install the Control container first.
Container.Requires: NexusBackup-Control must be installed and running. The Agent intentionally uses host networking so http://127.0.0.1:8787 reaches the local Control container. Review all storage mappings before running jobs.

Config.Name: Agent config
Config.Description: Persistent agent.json, rclone config and local backup credentials. Use exactly the same host path as /agent-config in the Control template.

Config.Name: Shared runtime
Config.Description: Read-only access to the agent token generated by Control. Use exactly the same host path as the Control Shared runtime mapping.

Config.Name: Agent state
Config.Description: Persistent mount state, rclone VFS cache and restic cache.

Config.Name: Backup source root
Config.Description: Read-only host data visible to Nexus Backup. Point this at the specific share/directory to protect; do not map the whole /mnt/user tree unless deliberately required and containment has been reviewed.

Config.Name: Local repository root
Config.Description: Default host location for local Restic repositories. Change this to the pool/share you want to hold backup data.

Config.Name: Restore staging root
Config.Description: Host location used by configured restore targets. Restores only write here when the target is explicitly enabled in agent.json.

Config.Name: Transfer destination root
Config.Description: Default local destination root for managed Copyarr-style transfers. Change this to your actual download/import share.

Config.Name: Control URL
Config.Description: Local Control endpoint. With both templates on host networking, leave this at 127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: Agent ID
Config.Description: Bundled local agent identity. Keep this identical in both templates.

Config.Name: Agent token file
Config.Description: Generated by Control in the shared runtime mapping. Do not replace this with a browser-visible token.
